The only Washington SNOTEL named Trinity is 1171:WA:SNTL (Chelan Co., since 2010-08-18), about 45 km from the stored point (48.05,-121.45, Snohomish Co.); the nearest AWDB stations to that point are discontinued snow courses and Decline Creek SNOTEL (1319, since 2018). Every one of those Washington candidates has AWDB dcoCode OR. An NRCS Oregon news item says the Portland Data Collection Office's operational area covers Oregon and Washington, and the Oregon Data Collection Office contact page lists Matt Warbritton as Supervisory Hydrologist, so he is recorded as manager at LOW confidence because the station itself is not pinned down. The Washington snow survey page and April 2026 Washington outlook report name Toby Rodgers as Water Supply Specialist (report contact), a forecasting role, not station operations; not recorded. No ORCID tied (Warbritton's ORCID record lists no employment).

Facility URL sitenum=685 is still Patterson Hollow #1, CO (see R-PEOPLE2-HYDRO-CRYO-01a); the real station is Lyman Lake 606:WA:SNTL, Chelan Co., since 1978-10-01, 1.3 km from the stored point, so the identity is clear. AWDB gives it dcoCode OR (Oregon). The NRCS Oregon news item (June 2023) says the Portland Data Collection Office's operational area covers Oregon and Washington; the current Oregon Data Collection Office contact page lists Matt Warbritton as Supervisory Hydrologist. Recorded as manager, MEDIUM: office-level, no page names a station manager. The 2023 news item named Sean Fleming as Portland DCO Supervisory Hydrologist; no page says he has left, so he is not recorded as a past holder. ORCID 0000-0002-0286-4940 (Matthew Warbritton) has no employment or education entries, so it is not tied to him.

SCAN is administered nationally, not by a state snow survey office: AWDB gives the station dcoCode 'GC', which the AWDB dcos reference list names 'SCAN'. The NRCS SCAN page says the National Water and Climate Center administers SCAN, and the NWCC program page says NWCC co-administers SCAN with the National Soil Survey Center. No fetched NRCS page names a person responsible for SCAN stations or for SCAN data collection: the NWCC contact page names a Director of the Snow Survey and Water Supply Forecasting Program and a Water and Climate Monitoring Team Lead, but neither is tied to SCAN on any page, so nobody is recorded. The NWCC station page and site notes name no people. Walnut Gulch #1 (Cochise Co.) has reported since 1999-03-19. Existing data-manager row for Dino DeSimone: the data.gov record (modified 2025-11-22, publisher Agricultural Research Service) still names him as the dataset contact point, so it is confirmed but kept LOW (a dataset contact, not a station role); he is not on the NRCS Arizona state office contacts page, whose snow survey contact is a Water Supply Specialist not tied to SCAN. No ORCID found for him.

Atigun Pass 957:AK:SNTL (North Slope, since 1981-10-01) has AWDB dcoCode AK, the Alaska snow survey office. The NRCS Alaska state office contacts page lists Daniel Fisher as Alaska Snow Survey Program Manager, and the April 2026 Alaska Water Supply Outlook Report (published by him as Snow Survey Program Manager) carries Atigun Pass SNOTEL in its data tables. Existing manager row confirmed and raised from low to MEDIUM: program-level, no page names a station manager. ORCID search found only a Daniel Fisher at USDA ARS, not tied to NRCS Alaska; none recorded.
